name: Claude Code (Subscription)
description: Run the official logged-in Claude Code CLI as a Buzz agent on Windows.

args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; [Console]::InputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $c=Get-Command claude.exe,claude.cmd -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $c){[Console]::Error.WriteLine('BUZZ_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND'); exit 127}; $p=([Console]::In.ReadToEnd()|ConvertFrom-Json); $f=[IO.Path]::GetTempFileName(); try{[IO.File]::WriteAllText($f,[string]$p.mcpConfig,[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)); $a=@($p.args|ForEach-Object{if($_ -eq '__BUZZ_MCP_CONFIG__'){$f}else{$_}}); & {$p.prompt}|& $c.Source @a; $x=$LASTEXITCODE}finally{Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}; exit $x
